summary: Berkshire County, MA tower on Alander Mountain, erected 1928, moved to Washburn Mtn (NY) in 1933 and Beebe Hill in 1963; footings and watchman's cabin remain.

facts.agency: Erected by the Taconic State Park Commission; operated by the NY State DEC or Forest Fire Control from about 1935 (the two entries differ)

staffing.status: Staffed 1928 to 1930; a 1929 photo caption names observer Mervin Whitbeck

access.note: Site lies in Mount Washington State Forest; the watchman's cabin is a campsite; the tower itself is gone

visit.trail_note: Reached by the Alander Mountain Trail; the watchman's cabin is on the route and the summit has old tower footings

events.note: Erected by the Taconic State Park Commission for fire detection on park land
Photo caption names observer Mervin Whitbeck
The area at Alander Mountain burned
Dismantled and stored at Taconic State Park / the High Falls facility
Re-erected on Washburn Mountain in Copake Falls, NY
Operation passed to the NY DEC (entry 1) or Forest Fire Control (entry 2)
Moved to Beebe Hill; November 1963 per entry 2, 1963-64 per the 2026 account
Four footings remained at the site as of 2005
Second FFLOS entry for the same tower, registered October 6, 2009 (US 544)
2026 hiking account says the four concrete footings remain

corrections.proposed: FFLOS US 45 and US 544 (second entry for the same tower, registered 2009)
corrections.why: US 544 describes the same tower and the same 1928-1963 history under its own registration
The register entry describes a 60-foot steel tower

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Entry US 45 gives 2,239 ft (682 m); entry US 544 gives 2,145 ft (654 m). The brief keeps 682.4 m from US 45.
US 45 gives 42.088830, -73.502670 and US 544 gives 42.092500, -73.504444. The brief keeps the US 45 point.

US 45 says the New York State DEC ran the tower from the start. US 544 says the Taconic State Park Commission erected it and that operation passed to Forest Fire Control about 1935. The story reports both.
US 544 dates the move to November 1963; the 2026 hiking account says 1963-64.

notes_for_editor: Two FFLOS entries describe this tower: US 45 (2008, the brief's record) and US 544 'Alander Mountain Tower Site' (2009). They agree on 1928, 1930, 1933 and 1963 but differ on elevation, coordinates and the agency for 1928-1935. Consider merging or cross-linking the two entries. A 1929 observer photo is on the US 544 page, but its image URL was not retrievable, so no photo was added. The 2026 Civilized Hiking post is the only recent source for the footings.
